name: TapeOsc
description: Varispeed oscillator with tape motor start/stop. One platform band-limited saw, square, triangle, or sine is written to a tape and slowed down like a deck.

params.name: WAVE
params.detail: Waveform: saw, square, triangle, sine. Uses the logue band-limited tables.

params.name: START
params.detail: Tape motor spin-up time in milliseconds (10-2000)

params.name: STOP
params.detail: Tape motor spin-down time in milliseconds (10-4000). Starts when the key is released.

params.name: WEAR
params.detail: Lo-fi wear: hiss, saturation, droop, dropouts

params.name: WOW
params.detail: Wow and flutter depth, 0-100%. 100% is about ±10% tape speed.
